description: Use this when a user asks what is stored, agrees to have their audit scores tracked, or asks to stop tracking. Stores the consent decision for derived funnel scores and, separately, for a strategy-call request. Only ever called in response to an explicit user decision — never proactively, and never as a default prompt at the end of a conversation.

allowStrategyContact.description: True to allow a strategy-call request to be stored and contacted.

optOut.description: True to delete all stored data for this user and stop tracking.

storeAuditScores.description: True to store derived funnel scores so progress can be tracked over time.

name: growth.set_privacy_consent
title: Set Privacy Consent
